collection.title: Mercedes-Benz E-Class Cabriolet 1993 to 1999 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz E-Class Cabriolet 1993 to 1999 model which requires a single 24" wiper blade. This model uses the Mercedes-Benz Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
